verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only live, session-based voice conversations: one WebSocket per conversation, function calling during a live call, and telephony for inbound and outbound calls. It shows no product-provided way to set up automations that run on their own in the background, such as recurring schedules, triggers or unattended jobs. Outbound calling and function calling are building blocks a developer would have to orchestrate, not an automation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
